meta.setting: State of Leonida (Vice City, Leonida Quays, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, Mount Kalaga National Park, the Leonida Keys)
meta.disclaimer: PROJECTED LIST. Rockstar Games has not published an official trophy guide as of this writing. All 55 names below are modelled on the GTA V PS5 trophy structure and on launch-week community tracking (GTA BOOM, GTABase, gta.guide), and are clearly labelled as projections until Rockstar's own documentation exists. Grades, difficulty ratings, missability flags and routes are the author's projections and may change with patches or a future GTA Online trophy add-on.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.missableNote: No individual trophy is unrepeatable after the credits, and the whole list is single-player. Cheats reportedly disable trophies and saving, so keep them off for the entire run.
trophies.description: Unlock every other trophy and be crowned a Leonida Legend. The run spans story, 100% completion, collectibles, heists, activities and partnership play. Budget 150-200 hours and follow the roadmap. PS5 Platinum; the Xbox equivalent tops out the 1,000 Gamerscore list.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.missableNote: Opening mission; cannot be skipped or failed permanently.
trophies.description: Complete the opening mission 'Gone Fishing'. Jason runs jobs on the marina in the Leonida Keys while Lucia serves her sentence. A gentle tutorial covering boating, fishing and the Keys' unhurried pace.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.missableNote: Story-progression trophy; unmissable.
trophies.description: Complete Chapter 1. Lucia walks out of prison, the couple settles into the stilt house, and their first 'easy score' goes wrong. Bank optional cash from early missions — it pays for garages and heist prep later.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.missableNote: Story-progression trophy; unmissable.
trophies.description: Complete Chapter 2. The botched job puts Jason and Lucia in debt to serious people. The drug-running loop you learn here is reused for laundering income later ('Dime on the Dollar').

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.missableNote: Story-progression trophy; unmissable.
trophies.description: Complete Chapter 3 — the flight into Vice City itself. Expect the game's first real difficulty spike: invest in body armor, a good long gun and a fast car before the city chapters begin.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.missableNote: Story-progression trophy; unmissable.
trophies.description: Complete Chapter 4, where the conspiracy stretching across Leonida tightens around the couple. Watch which gangs run which operations from here on — that map feeds the 'Pest Control' trophy.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.missableNote: Final mission. Free-roam does not end after the credits — Leonida stays fully open for clean-up.
trophies.description: Complete the final mission. Before triggering the endgame, clear anything chapter-locked: partnership-choice trophies, all heists, and collectibles behind story progress. After the credits, the world remains open for the 100% grind.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.missableNote: Story mission; unmissable.
trophies.description: Complete 'Breakfast Run'. A tense delivery mission that doubles as the tutorial for the relationship system — making coffee, holding hands. The small stuff that later feeds partnership trophies like 'Personal Best'.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.missableNote: Approach choices at the Cartel Heist may lock out one-time loot variants; save before the planning board.
trophies.description: Complete 'The Cartel Heist', the story's centrepiece score. Both the loud and quiet approaches award the trophy, but the quiet approach demands the same stealth discipline as 'Sneakthief' — practice on smaller scores first.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.missableNote: Story mission; unmissable.
trophies.description: Complete 'Child's Play'. Lucia's Liberty City family history comes back into frame. Mostly narrative with light combat — a breather mission to spend laundered cash between heists.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.missableNote: Story mission; unmissable.
trophies.description: Complete 'Headliners', a set piece inside one of Vice City's nightclubs. A live crowd, social-media gangsters and a messy exit. A stronger relationship meter improves partner support AI in the chaos.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.missableNote: Story mission; unmissable.
trophies.description: Complete 'VCIA Takedown', the airport sequence. This is also where 'Catch Me If You Can' becomes possible — the runway is the one place you can make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.missableNote: Story mission; unmissable.
trophies.description: Complete 'Operation Savage Glory', as law-enforcement pressure comes to a head. Stock ammo and armor beforehand — the checkpoint structure punishes an unprepared loadout more than shaky aim.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.missableNote: Reachable after the credits, but several 100% checklist items are easier (or only possible) before finishing the story — see the roadmap.
trophies.description: Attain 100% completion. Projected requirements: all story missions, all stranger strands, all collectible sets, every activity type at least once, gold Shooting Range challenges, 20 race wins, full exploration of Leonida, all garages and 10 registered vehicles. The single biggest chunk of the platinum.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.missableNote: Stunts never expire, but ramps in story-locked districts are unreachable until those chapters open.
trophies.description: Complete 250 stunts. Vice City's overpasses, beach ramps and pool gaps make this grindable — chain flips and near-misses in traffic-heavy districts and watch the in-game stunt counter climb.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.missableNote: Some activity types (hunting, kayaking, court sports) sit in districts that unlock with story progress.
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once: projected list includes fishing, bowling, shooting range, drone races, street races, basketball, hunting, kayaking, gym workouts, meditating, clubbing and arcade games. One session of each is enough.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.missableNote: Challenge availability scales with story-unlocked weapons; wait for the endgame arsenal before grinding golds.
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. Practice recoil control on the free-fire stages and use Combat Focus to guarantee the time-bonus thresholds on the harder ones.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.missableNote: Courses in late-unlock districts need story progress; only first place counts per venue.
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Each course has a shortcut-heavy optimum line — replay until the win registers at that venue.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.missableNote: Races are repeatable; nothing missable.
trophies.description: Win 20 different races. Street races and drone races both count toward the projection. Upgrade one fast car and one motorcycle early — most circuits reward braking discipline over raw top speed.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.missableNote: Fishing spots in the Keys unlock early and stay open.
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Match your lure to the conditions and reel with the fish's direction — fighting the drag snaps lines. A relaxing palate cleanser between heists.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.missableNote: Nothing missable; arcades are permanent world fixtures.
trophies.description: Complete an arcade game. Vice City's arcades hold several cabinets — any full clear counts, and the retro beat-'em-ups are the most forgiving.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.missableNote: Stranger strands persist post-credits, but some gate on mid-story windows — pick them up as they appear.
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy. One of the eight stranger strands needed for 'Strangers & Freaks' — a character arc about second chances, projected to involve boats and bad decisions.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.missableNote: Grab it during the chapters when the strand is active.
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton. A Grassrivers conspiracy strand — cryptic tapes, swamp lights, and a payoff the trophy name winks at.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.missableNote: Grab it during the chapters when the strand is active.
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy. A biker strand in Port Gellhorn / Ambrosia territory with chases aplenty. Have a heavy bike registered before starting the last stage.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.missableNote: Clean districts in order rather than leaving all '?' markers for an endgame map pile-up.
trophies.description: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Projected strands include Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone plus three more. Some markers only appear at specific times of day — revisit at night if a '?' is missing.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.missableNote: Grab it during the chapters when the strand is active.
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy. A smuggling strand that reuses the Chapter 2 drug-run mechanics — the piloting leg wants an undamaged vehicle, so don't skip prep.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.missableNote: Grab it during the chapters when the strand is active.
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. A Vice City social-media-clout storyline about a wannabe influencer — part comedy, part chase, and one of the easier strand finales.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.missableNote: Meditation spots never expire; the cost is purely time.
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida, from Keys overlooks to Mount Kalaga vistas. The projected count is in the dozens — pair this pass with the 'The Goodtime State' exploration sweep.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.missableNote: Hunting windows may be time-of-day gated; the animal itself persists.
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. A Grassrivers / Mount Kalaga strand — mind the wind, move slowly, and tag the unique target quietly.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.missableNote: Collectibles persist post-credits; nothing missable, just long.
trophies.description: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Trading cards are scattered across shops, streets and interiors. Sweep one district at a time with a checklist to avoid the endgame needle-in-haystack hunt.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.missableNote: Locations persist; purely a time grind.
trophies.description: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Community consensus reads WAiNK as a tagging/sticker app mechanic — projected as the game's 100-location world-interaction collectible. 100 spots across Leonida takes real hours; sweep methodically.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.missableNote: Challenges are repeatable; nothing missable.
trophies.description: Complete 50 Challenges. The challenge board (stunt chains, headshot streaks, wheelie distances, hunting marks) pays out progressively — knock out three or four per session during your other grinds and this clears itself.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.missableNote: Repeatable; easiest to arrange deliberately post-story.
trophies.description: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape. Farm stars deliberately in Vice City, split up, and use partner support to break line of sight — a fast boat out of the port beats any car.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.missableNote: Repeatable; plan the route along a low-density commercial strip.
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Pick three adjacent stores, keep the heat alive between robberies, and exit via a prepared getaway vehicle.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.missableNote: Rare spawns (boats, aircraft, showroom exotics) are location- and chapter-gated — sweep late.
trophies.description: Discover 100 vehicles. Discovery registers on first use, not first sight: drive, fly or pilot each one. Street traffic covers the common cars; fill the rest from the port, airport, marinas and showrooms.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.missableNote: Repeatable; respawn enemies at a known ambush spot.
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Enter the bullet-time window with a full meter and chain a close-range cluster with a shotgun or SMG. Retry from a checkpoint-friendly firefight.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.missableNote: Requires VCIA access, which opens with story progress.
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Get onto the runway and take off in anything with wings, clearance be damned. Trigger a 3-star response for fun, then climb out of range.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.missableNote: Military-base access gates this; expect heavy wanted heat afterward.
trophies.description: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Steal a Rhino tank from the projected Leonida military installation and survive the ensuing heat. Plan a helicopter exit — a tank on a bridge draws every cop in the state.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.missableNote: Repeatable, but store layouts may rotate with story chapters; save before entering.
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Full stealth: case the store, handle cameras and staff quietly, and never trip the alarm. One alerted guard resets the attempt.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.missableNote: Vaults reset over time; plan the escape route before hitting the first one.
trophies.description: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vaults are repeatable high-value targets separate from the story heists. The getaway must complete for each robbery to count — five clean breaches, five clean exits.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.missableNote: Armored truck spawns are random; camp known routes.
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. The GTA V classic: intercept a securities truck on a quiet road, force the doors, grab the cash, lose the heat. Partner support shines here — one drives while the other breaches.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.missableNote: Most districts open with story; the last sliver unlocks at the endgame.
trophies.description: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every named district — Vice City, Leonida Quays, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, Mount Kalaga National Park and the Keys. Discovery triggers on entry; pair the sweep with the meditation and WAiNK grinds.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.missableNote: Gang operations reveal through story progress; do this after the credits once all factions are known.
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Projected factions across Leonida each run at least one robable operation — labs, chop shops, stash houses. The in-game notebook tracks which operations you've hit and under whose banner.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.missableNote: Nothing missable — a vibe check, not a challenge.
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. A pure flavor trophy: order a drink at an Ocean Beach bar with the ocean in sight. The perfect first-hour send-off after the years of waiting.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.missableNote: Repeatable; showroom glass respawns.
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive — or launch — a vehicle straight through a Vice City showroom's glass front. The homage is to every GTA showroom stunt ever clipped.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.missableNote: Nothing missable; the alley is always open.
trophies.description: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Complete a full game of bowling — and enjoy the community's favourite nod to a certain cousin from another game.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.missableNote: Repeatable; practice the pin physics a few frames first.
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The hard variant of bowling: clear all ten pins via a thrown melee-object physics gag (or, per community reading, a melee takedown on the approach). Experiment — both readings award the same trophy.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missableNote: The relationship meter is a slow burn; feed it across the whole run rather than grinding late.
trophies.description: A partnership with mass appeal. Max out the Jason-Lucia relationship system: date nights, dancing, shared meals, holding hands, couch TV. The meter rises across dozens of hours of small moments, not one session.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableNote: Story choices branch mid-chapter; keep a pre-choice save if you want to see both outcomes.
trophies.description: Choices made, for better or worse. Commit to a major story choice at a projected chapter fork. The trophy awards on committing — it does not require the 'good' outcome.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableNote: Trigger conditions may be probabilistic; keep playing and it will land.
trophies.description: Second time's the charm. A cryptic projection: fail a mission or chance event, then retry it successfully — community reading is losing a gamble twice before winning, or recovering a failed heist prep. Most players earn it naturally.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missableNote: Cryptic trigger, likely tied to a specific late-game or Easter-egg world event; save often.
trophies.description: What the hell just happened? The deliberately cryptic one. Projected to unlock after witnessing a specific unexplained world event — the X-Files nod suggests UFO or Grassrivers-lights lore. Hunt it after 100% when the map is fully known.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.missableNote: Laundering contacts unlock with story; income scales late-game.
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills accumulate from robberies and illegal operations; feed them through the laundering loop repeatedly. Post-story heist income makes the total trivial.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.missableNote: The total is cumulative across all shop types; visit every category at least once.
trophies.description: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The qualifier matters: buy something at every shop type — clothing, weapons, salons, mod shops, tattoo parlors — up to a $100k cumulative total. One Vice City shopping spree finishes it.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.missableNote: Some garages gate on story money milestones; buy them as districts open.
trophies.description: Purchase all garage properties. Garages across Leonida cost escalating sums, with Vice City's the priciest. Buy one per district as cash allows; post-story income covers the full set quickly.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.missableNote: The app unlocks early; nothing missable.
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The in-game registration app tracks your fleet — any ten vehicles you've driven count, and this overlaps naturally with the 'Whip It Good' discovery hunt.
